stations.title: Kwame
stations.say: Visit opens behind the big picture.

stations.title: Header
stations.text: The menu has a high z-index, inside it.

stations.title: Your styles
stations.gap: A layer that holds it down

captions: At the Wrenfield, Kwame clicks Visit and the menu opens behind the big picture.
The menu's high z-index only counts inside the header, and the picture wins.
You find the layer that holds the menu down and fix it, and the seat guides too.
Now the Visit menu opens on top, with Find us, Access and The cafe in view.
Same header, same picture. The layers are compared the right way round.
